A supervisor asks for a HOSTLER move of a trailer to a spot or door. The destination is validated now (known active slot of the site, closure, door flow, hold) and RESERVED: no two open moves share a destination (409 `destination-reserved`), the destination must be free (409 `location-occupied`), and a trailer has at most one open move (409 `trailer-has-open-move`). A trailer that is secured at its door (ADR 0013) is not moved away until the securing is released (409 `trailer-still-secured`). A trailer that carries a hazard class or needs temperature control is sent only to a yard spot its kind allows (409 `placement-rule-violated`, ADR 0014); the same rule judges the spot where the hostler completes the move.
